$comment: The permission block every OpenCode Eindri is launched with (plan 262, the twin of claude-worker.settings.json, plan 239 P5c). A worker runs unattended in its own Yggdrasil worktree, so it may act without a prompt, while the moves that only the Allfather makes, or that destroy unrecorded work, are denied. OpenCode matches the LAST rule that fits, so the allow-all comes first and the denials after it. bin/seat/opencode-launcher.sh merges this block into OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT.
